Expected Outcomes  预期成果

At the end of the series of lectures on BJTs, you should be able to :
在本系列关于双极型晶体管（BJT）的讲座结束时，您应该能够：
  • Describe the structure and doping of the various regions of the bipolar transistor;
    描述双极型晶体管各区域的结构和掺杂情况；
  • State the bias combinations at the junctions of the BJT for the various modes of operations;
    说明 BJT 各结点在不同工作模式下的偏置组合；
  • Explain the principle of operation of the BJT in terms of the movements of the electrons and holes through the device;
    解释 BJT 的工作原理，重点说明电子和空穴在器件中的运动。
  • Relate the terminal I-V characteristics and current gain of the BJT to its physical structures and biasing conditions.
    将 BJT 的端子 I-V 特性和电流增益与其物理结构及偏置条件联系起来。

1. Introduction  1. 引言

Cross-section of an integrated circuit npn bipolar transistor
集成电路 npn 双极型晶体管的横截面

◻ ◻ ◻\square All terminal connections required at the surface of the semiconductor.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 半导体表面所需的所有端子连接。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Buried n + + n + + n^(++)n^{++}layer required to minimise collector resistance.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 埋藏的 n + + n + + n^(++)n^{++} 层，用于最小化集电极电阻。
◻ ◻ ◻\square There is a need to isolate between transistors on the substrate using p + p + p^(+)p^{+}regions.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 需要使用 p + p + p^(+)p^{+} 区域在衬底上隔离晶体管。
◻ ◻ ◻\square The BJT is not a symmetrical device, the doping of the emitter and the collector are different.
◻ ◻ ◻\square BJT 不是对称器件，发射极和集电极的掺杂不同。
The Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) is a device comprising two pn junctions which are close enough to each other to interact.
双极结型晶体管（BJT）是一种由两个足够接近以相互作用的 pn 结组成的器件。
2 types: npn or pnp
两种类型：npn 或 pnp
3 regions: emitter, base, collector.
三个区域：发射极、基极、集电极。

2. Principles of Operation
2. 工作原理

Consider the npn transistor, in the forward active mode where: BE forward biased, BC reverse biased
考虑 npn 晶体管，在正向放大模式下：基极-发射极正向偏置，基极-集电极反向偏置

At the emitter-base junction:
在发射极-基极结处：

◻ ◻ ◻\square Due to the forward bias :
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于正向偏置：
◻ ◻ ◻\square The energy barrier is reduced.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 能量势垒降低。
  • Net diffusion of excess electrons from emitter into base,
    多余电子从发射极向基极的净扩散，
    ▹ ▹ ▹\triangleright Net diffusion of excess holes from base into emitter.
    ▹ ▹ ▹\triangleright 多余空穴从基极向发射极的净扩散。
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square Emitter doping >> base doping,
    ◻ ◻ ◻\square 发射极掺杂浓度远大于基极掺杂浓度，
    ≻ ≻ >-\succ Most of the charge carriers that cross the junction are electrons that diffuse from the emitter into the base.
    ≻ ≻ >-\succ 穿过结的大多数载流子是从发射极扩散到基极的电子。
Example  示例
If emitter doping = 99 × = 99 × =99 xx=99 \times base doping, then out of 100 charge carriers that cross the emitter-base junction, about 99 ― 99 _ 99 _\underline{99} are electrons and 1 is a hole.
如果发射极掺杂量 = 99 × = 99 × =99 xx=99 \times 基区掺杂量，那么在穿过发射极-基区结的 100 个电荷载流子中，大约有 99 ― 99 _ 99 _\underline{99} 个是电子，1 个是空穴。

In the neutral base region:
在中性基区：

◻ ◻ ◻\square The injected electrons are minority carriers (in npn transistor).
◻ ◻ ◻\square 注入的电子是少数载流子（在 npn 晶体管中）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square They diffuse across the neutral base towards to collector-base junction.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 它们扩散穿过中性基区，朝向集电极-基区结。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Very few of the electrons recombine with holes in the neutral base (Why ?)
◻ ◻ ◻\square 很少有电子在中性基区与空穴复合（为什么？）
◻ ◻ ◻\square Practically all the injected electrons are able to reach the collectorbase space charge region.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 几乎所有注入的电子都能到达集电极-基区空间电荷区。

At the collector-base junction:
在集电极-基区结处：

◻ ◻ ◻\square There is a large electric field in the space charge region due to the applied reverse bias.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 由于施加的反向偏压，空间电荷区存在较大的电场。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Normally the current that flows through a reverse-biased p-n junction is very small because of the low concentration of minority carriers.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 通常，流经反向偏置的 p-n 结的电流非常小，因为少数载流子的浓度较低。
◻ ◻ ◻\square However, in this case, there is a large supply of minority carriers (electrons in the npn transistor) that originate from the emitter.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 然而，在这种情况下，存在大量来自发射极的少数载流子（npn 晶体管中的电子）。
◻ ◻ ◻\square These electrons are swept by the electric field in the collector-base space charge region into the collector, to give rise to a large collector current.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 这些电子被集电极-基区空间电荷区的电场扫入集电极，产生较大的集电极电流。

Question:  问题：

What should be the thickness of the base, i.e., how close should the two p-n junctions be, in a bipolar junction transistor?
双极型结型晶体管中，基区的厚度应该是多少，即两个 p-n 结应该有多接近？

We shall first consider two extreme cases
我们首先考虑两个极端情况

  • Case 1 : Junctions are far apart - not interacting
    情况 1：结间距离较远——不相互作用
  • Case 2 : Junctions are very close together - highly interacting
    情况 2：结点非常接近——高度相互作用

Case 1 : Junctions far apart - not interacting
情况 1：结点相距较远——不相互作用

How close must the junctions be to interact?
结点必须多近才能相互作用？

◻ ◻ ◻\square Essence of interaction is the injection of electrons from the emitterbase junction which reaches the collector-base junction.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 交互的本质是从发射极-基极结注入电子，这些电子到达集电极-基极结。
◻ ◻ ◻\square Recombination of injected electrons in the neutral base region prevents them from reaching the collector.
◻ ◻ ◻\square 注入电子在中性基区的复合阻止它们到达集电极。
◻ ◻ ◻\square To avoid recombination, we need the width of the neutral base region to be much less than the diffusion length of the electrons in the base,
◻ ◻ ◻\square 为了避免复合，我们需要中性基区的宽度远小于电子在基区的扩散长度，
i.e., x B ≪ L n x B ≪ L n quadx_(B)≪L_(n)\quad x_{B} \ll L_{n}  也就是说， x B ≪ L n x B ≪ L n quadx_(B)≪L_(n)\quad x_{B} \ll L_{n}

从多余少数载流子分布的角度考虑相互作用

Case 1 : Distribution of excess minority carriers of an npn BJT in forward active mode when the base is very long.
情况 1：当基极很长时，npn 型双极结晶体管在正向放大模式下多余少数载流子的分布。

  • Assume long base, x B ≫ L n x B ≫ L n x_(B)≫L_(n)x_{B} \gg L_{n}.
    假设基极很长， x B ≫ L n x B ≫ L n x_(B)≫L_(n)x_{B} \gg L_{n} 。
  • x B x B x_(B)x_{B} - width of neutral base region
    x B x B x_(B)x_{B} - 中性基区宽度
  • Assume short emitter, x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p}.
    假设发射极较短， x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p} 。
    ∙ x E ∙ x E ^(∙)x_(E){ }^{\bullet} x_{E} - width of neutral emitter region
    ∙ x E ∙ x E ^(∙)x_(E){ }^{\bullet} x_{E} - 中性发射极区宽度

In the neutral base:
在中性基区：

  • The excess minority carriers (electrons in this case) injected from the emitter into the base diffuse through the neutral base towards the collector.
    从发射极注入基区的多余少数载流子（此处为电子）通过中性基区向集电极扩散。
  • In the process, they also recombine with the holes (majority carriers) in the base.
    在此过程中，它们也与基区中的空穴（多数载流子）复合。
  • Since the width of the neutral base, x B x B x_(B)x_{B}, is much greater than the minority carrier (electron) diffusion length, L n L n L_(n)L_{n}, practically all the excess minority carriers would have recombined within the neutral base.
    由于中性基区的宽度 x B x B x_(B)x_{B} 远大于少数载流子（电子）扩散长度 L n L n L_(n)L_{n} ，几乎所有多余的少数载流子都会在中性基区内复合。
  • The distribution of the excess minority carriers in the base is approximately an exponentially decreasing function.
    基区中多余少数载流子的分布大致呈指数递减函数。

In the neutral emitter :
在中性发射极：

  • It is assumed in this example that the neutral emitter width x E x E x_(E)x_{E} is much less than the minority carrier (hole) diffusion length, L p L p L_(p)L_{p}.
    本例中假设中性发射极宽度 x E x E x_(E)x_{E} 远小于少数载流子（空穴）扩散长度 L p L p L_(p)L_{p} 。
  • Practically all the holes injected from the base into the emitter will diffuse through the base without recombination to reach the emitter contact, where they will then recombine with electrons supplied from the external bias.
    几乎所有从基区注入发射极的空穴都会通过基区扩散而不复合，达到发射极接触处，然后与外部偏置提供的电子复合。
  • The minority carrier (hole) distribution in the emitter is practically a straight line.
    发射极中的少数载流子（空穴）分布几乎是一条直线。

Case 2: Distribution of excess minority carriers of an npn BJT in forward active mode when the base is very short.
情况 2：当基区非常短时，npn 型双极结晶体管在正向放大模式下多余少数载流子的分布。

  • Assume short base, x B ≪ L n x B ≪ L n x_(B)≪L_(n)x_{B} \ll L_{n}.
    假设基区很短， x B ≪ L n x B ≪ L n x_(B)≪L_(n)x_{B} \ll L_{n} 。
  • Assume short emitter, x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p}.
    假设发射区很短， x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p} 。
  • Note : In both case 1 and case 2, the collector is assumed long. This is, however, immaterial to the operation discussed here.
    注意：在情况 1 和情况 2 中，集电区都假设为很长。然而，这对这里讨论的操作无关紧要。

In the neutral base:
在中性基区：

  • The excess minority carriers (electrons in this case) injected from the emitter into the base diffuse through the neutral base towards the collector.
    从发射极注入基区的多余少数载流子（此处为电子）通过中性基区扩散，朝向集电极。
  • Since the width of the neutral base, x B x B x_(B)x_{B}, is much less than the minority carrier (electron) diffusion length, L n L n L_(n)L_{n}, practically no excess minority carriers recombine within the neutral base.
    由于中性基区宽度 x B x B x_(B)x_{B} 远小于少数载流子（电子）扩散长度 L n L n L_(n)L_{n} ，实际上几乎没有多余的少数载流子在中性基区内复合。
  • The minority carrier (electron) diffusion current through the neutral base is constant.
    通过中性基区的少数载流子（电子）扩散电流是恒定的。
  • The distribution of the excess minority carriers in the base is practically a straight line.
    基区中多余少数载流子的分布几乎是一条直线。

In the neutral emitter:
在中性发射极：

  • The distribution of the minority carriers (holes) in the neutral emitter is practically a straight line, as x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p}.
    少数载流子（空穴）在中性发射极中的分布几乎是一条直线，如 x E ≪ L p x E ≪ L p x_(E)≪L_(p)x_{E} \ll L_{p} 所示。

3. Analysis of bipolar junction transistor
3. 双极结型晶体管分析

RECALL: 2 extreme cases that we have considered:
回顾：我们考虑过的两个极端情况：
(a) a very long base, all injected electrons (for npn transistor) recombine in the base;
(a) 一个非常长的基区，所有注入的电子（对于 npn 晶体管）都在基区复合；
(a) a very short base & zero recombination of injected electrons in the base.
(a) 非常短的基区和基区内注入电子的零复合。
NOW: A real bipolar transistor is something in between :
现在：一个真正的双极型晶体管介于两者之间：
There is a small amount recombination in the base, but most (>99%) of the injected electrons (for npn transistor) manage to diffuse across the base and reach the collector without recombination.
基区内有少量复合，但大多数（>99%）注入的电子（对于 npn 晶体管）能够扩散穿过基区并到达集电极而不发生复合。

3.1 BJT current components
3.1 BJT 电流组成


i E n i E n i_(En)i_{E n}
i E p i E p i_(Ep)i_{E p}
i B a i B a i_(Ba)i_{B a}
i B b i B b i_(Bb)\boldsymbol{i}_{\boldsymbol{B} \boldsymbol{b}} is the hole current from the base which supplies the holes for recombination in the base.
i B b i B b i_(Bb)\boldsymbol{i}_{\boldsymbol{B} \boldsymbol{b}} 是来自基极的空穴电流，为基极中的复合提供空穴。
i C n i C n i_(Cn)i_{C n}
i C p i C p i_(Cp)i_{C p}
is the collector current component due to the part of the injected emitter electrons ( i E n i E n i_(En)\boldsymbol{i}_{E n} ) which do no recombine in the base and manage to reach the collector.
是由于注入发射极电子（ i E n i E n i_(En)\boldsymbol{i}_{E n} ）中未在基区复合并设法到达集电极的部分所产生的集电极电流分量。

是由于反向偏置的集电极-基区结产生的漏电流中的空穴分量，且其值可以忽略不计。

TRANSISTOR ACTION  晶体管作用

Example 1  例子 1

Objective: To calculate the collector current given the minority carrier injection in the base.
目标：计算基区少数载流子注入下的集电极电流。
Consider an npn transistor with a uniform cross-sectional area of 0.1 mm 2 0.1 mm 2 0.1mm^(2)0.1 \mathrm{~mm}^{2} which has an excess electron concentration of 8.5 × 10 15 cm − 3 8.5 × 10 15 cm − 3 8.5 xx10^(15)cm^(-3)8.5 \times 10^{15} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3} maintained at the emitter-base junction. The collector-base junction is reverse biased. If the width of the neutral base region is 5 μ m 5 μ m 5mum5 \mu \mathrm{~m} and the electron mobility is 1500 cm 2 V − 1 S − 1 1500 cm 2 V − 1 S − 1 1500cm^(2)V^(-1)S^(-1)1500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \mathrm{~V}^{-1} \mathrm{~S}^{-1}, estimate the collector current. The doping in the base, N A B = 2.25 × 10 17 cm − 3 N A B = 2.25 × 10 17 cm − 3 N_(AB)=2.25 xx10^(17)cm^(-3)N_{A B}=2.25 \times 10^{17} \mathrm{~cm}^{-3}. Summary of Modes of Operation

The bipolar transistor has two junctions which can be either forward or reverse-biased. This leads to four possible bias combinations or modes of operation:
